'''Torque ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] mechanic living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. Having a natural talent for starship engine maintenance, but not for people, Torque worked as a chief engineer on a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] cruiser until he was convicted for battering his colleagues. After serving time, Torque left Republic space and eventually settled on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], where he joined the [[Ravagers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] gang. Becoming a chief engineer of the ''[[Soaring Duros]]'', he preferred to work only with droids, such as [[BO-55]], an [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] that he retrofitted and reprogrammed into a killing machine.<ref name="Codex" /> In [[3637 BBY]] the ''Soaring Duros'' was docked in [[Coratanni Town]] when it was boarded by a group hired by the former Ravagers [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Ruugar]]. Torque defended his engine room, but was eventually overwhelmed and killed.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chief Engineer Torque appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion, released on [[December 2]], [[2014]].
